content:
maya (product): Quick topic - we need to finalize GA criteria for BYOK/KMS + audit evidence for enterprise customers. Goal: gated opt-in, Q3. Questions: export format, rotation rehearsal, retention SLAs, SOC2 artifacts.

jin (eng-runtime): What should count as "done" for GA? Minimal surface?

maya (product): Rough minimal GA: tenant-level key handshake success path, rotation API + observable rollback, per-tenant retention settings in Console, signed evidence export (including manifest), and SRE runbook with rehearsal test.

priya (eng-sre): Practicals: rehearse rotation in a non-prod environment, automated reconciliation to detect drift, alerting for handshake/rotate failures, and a post-rotation smoke test. Need a postmortem template if rehearsal causes regressions.

carlos (security): From security side: HSM-backed KEK for Dedicated/Private, provable rotation attestations with signatures, documented escrow flow and least-privilege access model. SOC2 wants chain-of-custody for keys + logs.

zoe (customer-success): Customers will demand a dry-run mode and a migration window. Ask customers (Acme, Nova) to participate in pilot. They also want export previews (redacted) before full export.

maya (product): Proposed launch gates (owners + acceptance):
- KMS handshake + rotate endpoints (jin): smoke + integration tests hitting handshake/rotate/status
- Rehearsal automation (priya): automated dry-run against pilot tenant, reconciliation report
- Console retention UI (product/devex): per-tenant TTL, role-restricted views
- Evidence export (security/product): zip with signed manifest + trace id, export SLA 2h
- SOC2 mapping (security): mapping doc + sample exports for 5 controls

jin (eng-runtime): Implementation note: we'll build API stubs for escrow and flag enterprise-only until escrow integration is complete. Also add fallback path: ephemeral warmed keyholder when KMS unreachable and emit keystore.unavailable metric.

priya (eng-sre): Rehearsal checklist draft:
1) schedule pilot dry-run (Acme)
2) run `keystore-rehearsal --simulate-rotate --tenant=acme`
3) verify token issuance and KV cache invalidation across regions
4) export evidence, validate signature & manifest
5) run perf smoke (qps/p95) and reconciliation job

deploy-bot: created rehearsal environment: env=keystore-pilot-2024-07-10 link=https://console/rehearsals/keystore-pilot-2024-07-10

carlos (security): Evidence export fields must include: key_id, rotation_ts, attestation_sig, requester_identity, http_trace_id, and artifact hash. Retention TTL for exported artifacts configurable per-customer.

zoe (customer-success): UX asks: Console shows "BYOK status" card: last rotation, next scheduled rotation (if auto), export button, and redacted view for non-admins. Provide CLI export option for compliance teams.

maya (product): Decisions to surface: default hosted retention = 90 days, enterprise contract option >=365 days, export SLA 2 hours for GA, pilot rehearsal required prior to enabling tenant opt-in.

jin (eng-runtime): Agree on enterprise opt-in flag. Add metric hooks: `keystore.handshake.latency`, `keystore.rotate.failure`, `evidence.export.duration`, `evidence.export.failure`. Emit high-severity alert if fallback used.

priya (eng-sre): I'll author alert thresholds and the reconciliation job that lists mismatched key state per-region. Also adding postmortem template to runbook.

carlos (security): I'll draft SOC2/ISO control mapping and provide sample artifacts. Flag legal for export retention and data subject request edge cases.

zoe (customer-success): Will confirm Acme availability for week of July 8 and collect compliance questions.

maya (product): Action items & due dates:
- jin: API parity + integration tests (due 2024-06-30)
- priya: rehearsal runbook + automation (due 2024-07-05)
- carlos: SOC2 mapping + evidence spec (due 2024-06-20)
- zoe: pilot coordination (Acme) (due 2024-07-01)
- maya: retention policy + pricing note (due 2024-06-25)

jin (eng-runtime): I'll open PR for API stubs and a feature flag for enterprise opt-in today.

priya (eng-sre): Schedule rehearsal job in CI and add reconciliation smoke.

carlos (security): Legal looped in — sending export retention proposal to legal.

zoe (customer-success): I'll assemble a pilot checklist for Acme and Nova.

maya (product): Follow-up: gate review meeting Mon 2024-06-17 10:30. Update PR: https://git/repo/keystore-gates PR#87. Aim for rehearsal + go/no-go checklist before enabling opt-in. :white_check_mark:

jin (eng-runtime): :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled: rehearsal-job/keystore-pilot-2024-07-10 -> status=scheduled

zoe (customer-success): Confirmed Acme for July 10 rehearsal.

maya (product): Thanks everyone. Keep updates in the PR and flag blockers early.
